output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home for now with rest, and protect the ankle while it settles. Rolling the ankle with swelling, bruising and some ability to bear weight most often reflects a ligament sprain. If you become unable to put any weight on it, the pain sharply worsens, the ankle looks deformed, or the foot goes numb, cold or pale, get seen in person the same day (urgent care or emergency department). If it is not clearly improving over the next week or two, arrange a clinician review.
